title: Master Yan and Wu Sha
summary: Lin Dong goes with his grandfather and father to Yan City to sell Yang Yuan Stone in secret. At the Mysterious Objects Tower he trades nine Yang Yuan Pills for a Qiankun Bag and tries to buy an ancient divine wood fragment, but Zi Yue claims it. Her master, Master Yan, stops the quarrel with mental strength, explains Symbol Masters, invites Lin Dong to be his student and gives him a book. Lin Dong declines for now to protect the Stone Talisman's secret, then learns the Black Dragon Stockade has attacked the Lin family home and Ironwood Manor. At the manor he fights the second chief Wu Sha, a Heavenly Yuan fighter, while Qing Tan and Little Flame hold the gate. Beaten down with his Yuan Power spent, Lin Dong breaks through to Heavenly Yuan, kills Wu Sha, and Lei Bao vows to bring in outside help.
events: Lei Bao and Xie Qian learn the Lin family is selling Yang Yuan Stone and plot an attack.
Lin Dong buys a Qiankun Bag at the Mysterious Objects Tower for nine Yang Yuan Pills.
Zi Yue disputes the ancient wood fragment; Master Yan intervenes, offers to teach Lin Dong and gives him a book.
Lin Shan brings word that the Black Dragon Stockade has surrounded the Lin home.
Lin Dong rushes to Ironwood Manor and fights Wu Sha, who uses Wind-Tearing Hand and the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle.
Lin Dong uses the Qimen Seal up to its third layer, then breaks through to Heavenly Yuan.
Lin Dong kills Wu Sha; the Lei family is alarmed and Lei Bao plans to fetch a stronger ally.
cultivation: Wu Sha is at Heavenly Yuan. Lin Dong is at Earthly Yuan late, then breaks through to Heavenly Yuan during the fight. Lei Bao is close to Yuan Dan initial.

flags: Master Yan is not named in this episode (called 大师/师父); EP6 names him 岩大师. Card 629.8 is him addressing Lin Dong.
Zi Yue's name is 紫月 in the subtitles; names.txt has 籽月. Same English.
Purchase of the ancient wood is implied: Zi Yue lets him go (580.8) and EP6 calls it 上次收来的古木. The book (698.2) is named 神动篇 in EP6; the shuttle is Wu Sha's, which Lin Dong controls in EP6.
The Heavenly Yuan stage after the breakthrough is not stated.
names.txt lists Mo Ling (Dao Sect) first in EP5; nobody of that name appears in the subtitles.
1372.6 someone calls Lei Bao 爷爷 (grandfather) at the Lei house, though EP6 has Lei Bao call Lei Li 我儿; the speaker is unclear, so Lei Li is not in cast.
